title: Heavy Expansion
description: This mod expands on the heavy core block from the 1.21 tricky trials update
body:
![mod banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48dde766c558b39fbd13bb6e1bc31789989d3702.png)

This mod expands on the heavy core block from the 1.21 tricky trials update and adds a new armor
set a new sword and new items paired with it to start you will need a heavy core and put it in a blast furnace to smelt
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f19e0a86d0916dffe004f2bf90259f91b1ba9a3.png)

once its smelted you will get a molten core
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46c857fe3db618964e5326f1167a4eb812789ee0.png)

with said molten core when put into a smithing table with these items
you will ubtain molten items to tuen into the new armor and sword
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b05c491f020fa5700808b911c9eb350fa83c771f.png)
And too craft the item casts. You craft them like so with there corresponding iron tool 
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86c4e44c4c324a37e11f89ac15bc31c8ef5223d5.png)
And once you have gotten the molten tool if you right click them on a cauldron with water in it you will get your new item
